verdict.rationale: Drata documents OAuth setup for its public API v2 (drata-docs-6) and says AI agents can interact with Drata via an official MCP server (drata-docs-2, drata-probe-4), so issuing API credentials for an agent is plausible. However, nothing in the evidence shows those credentials can be scoped or limited to least privilege. The 'READ ONLY' items describe the endpoint device agent's access to system preferences, not API credential scoping. Missing for 10: documented per-credential scopes or permission levels, read-only or least-privilege API key options, agent-specific credential guidance, independent corroboration.
